name: Adretian Empire
desc:
The Adretian Empire was a nation that existed during the Resurgence. The Empire was eventually plague by a calamity known as the Godstorm, which killed the Adretian Emperor. The Godstorm was allegedly dispelled by [Drallis Ehr](entity:drallis_ehr), who took control of the kingdom.

Drallis would go on to convert the Empire and other nations, who had willingly joined their coalition, into [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) in 65 BCE.
